'''DE-13''' was a [[Factory/Legends|factory]] located in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Jorra]], which was itself located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]]. The factory primarily produced [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and [[Computer/Legends|computer]] parts. It was affiliated with [[Tagge Company/Legends|TaggeCo]], and employed [[Tor Haido]].<ref name="CotG" />
